digest.component_or_area: DC backend test suite and outbound field mapping
propositions: DC backend has no value-pinned characterization test and risks undetected regressions in priority/status maps, sanitizer boundaries, identity labels, and probe branches that Cloud's pinned suite already guards

The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote body is exercised only through AdfCodec, leaving DC's WikiTextCodec composition unvalidated and unable to catch regressions like dropped length fits or mapping errors

DC's create-path mapper _map_local_to_dc_fields must be pinned by VALUE for every key (summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee) including all default-fallback and empty-string branches
DC sanitizer boundaries for summary, description, and comment must be pinned at-limit AND one-over with exact truncation suffix marker validation

DC probe classification must be pinned against the REAL classifier for all four branches (PRESENT_RESOLVED, PRESENT_FILTERED, ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, UNREACHABLE) and must prove DC binds its own resolved_statuses set, not Cloud's
